Thermal Release Request

The Department (NYSDEC) requests releases from the FFMP2017 Thermal Mitigation Bank from Cannonsville, Pepacton, and Neversink due to the extremely warm weather. We request a 300 cfs increase to the release from Cannonsville Reservoir, a 25 cfs increase at Pepacton Reservoir and a 25 cfs increase at Neversink Reservoir.
